summary: Frontend-only visual/interaction testing of Actalink static landing page. All 27 required data-testid elements present. Lenis smooth scroll exposed on window.__lenis and functional. Nav links, hero CTA, and Get-in-touch scroll to correct sections. Product-flow cards render light/white with blue accents (not green). Products section shows 4 dark cards; hover works. Manifesto with 3 chapters, marquee, and footer render correctly. No console errors, no page runtime errors. Mobile 390px shows no horizontal overflow; desktop 1440px renders cleanly.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Static site, no backend. Use window.__lenis.scrollTo(y,{immediate:true}) to bypass Lenis for verification. All data-testids match spec. Hero heading textContent concatenates without spaces because lines are separated by block-level spans; visual layout is correct (3 lines) — not a bug.
